aliasing: S2 and S3 share the same H-CTA-major workspace without restore/transpose
CuTe metadata aliases are created inside the compiled TVM-FFI host stub and must not create ATen hot-path operations
layout_constraints: all tensor addresses are on the same CUDA device
all dynamic tensor pointers satisfy the production assumed alignment

computation.definition: For B=1, H=16, D=128 and chunk size C=64, consume causal-conv Q/K/V activations plus z/beta/decay logits. S01 computes per-token per-head Q/K L2 normalization, beta=sigmoid(beta_logit), log-decay from decay_logit, the chunk-local causal K K^T system and its triangular solve, then materializes qhat, packed K/W/U and cumulative log-decay. S2 performs the ordered chunk recurrence with initial_state=None, producing corrected V and inter-chunk H state. S3 combines the local causal QK contribution with the recurrent H contribution and writes BF16 raw output. Post computes RMS across the D=128 value dimension and writes y=(raw_o*rsqrt(mean(raw_o^2)+epsilon))*norm_weight*(z*sigmoid(z)). No final recurrent state is returned.
dependencies: S01 -> S2: packed K, packed W, packed U, cumulative log-decay
S01 -> S3: qhat, packed K, cumulative log-decay
S2 -> S3: corrected V and H state in H-CTA-major layout
post reduction axis: D=128 independently for every token and head
forbidden_rewrites: Change chunk size C=64, H=16, D=128 or BF16 public tensor contract
Introduce non-null initial state or materialize a final state
Move allocation, compilation, tensor view construction or device synchronization onto the hot path
Use results from padded tokens in valid-token outputs
Relax numerical acceptance without separate user authorization
legal_rewrites: Change CTA/warp/role partition, instruction schedule, buffering, vector width and stage ownership on sm_120
Fuse stages or remove intermediate materialization only when the public ABI and numerical acceptance contract remain satisfied
Pad sequence to P=ceil(S/64)*64 internally while masking invalid tokens
Use CuTe DSL, CUDA C++ or inline PTX and architecture-specific sm_120 instructions
Cache compilation artifacts, launch metadata and plan-owned workspaces outside the hot path

inputs.layout: logical [1,3*H*D,S], physical channel-last rows [S,3*H*D] written by causal-conv
inputs.name: mixed_qkv

numerics.acceptance: Bitwise equality at the current observable BF16/FP32 stage boundaries and final BF16 output for controlled scheduling rewrites; any change to a rounding boundary requires separate authorization and a pre-registered tolerance test
numerics.accumulation_dtype: FP32 for reductions, recurrence state and MMA accumulators unless the frozen production source explicitly rounds an intermediate to BF16
numerics.reference: Frozen current production four-kernel CuTe SM120 implementation, cross-checked against the FLA gated-delta reference semantics
